sections.content: The acceptance CLI provides deterministic preparation, validation, evidence, coordinator, routing, bootstrap integration, persistence, replay, and finalization commands. Inputs and outputs are hash-bound, append-only, repository-contained, and non-authorizing.
sections.title: Acceptance CLI

sections.content: The plan requires persisted coordinator evidence, reentrant successor handling, continuity of maintainer-controlled bindings, controlled Knowledge freshness recovery, legacy RED compatibility checks, read-only historical verification, and completion handoff integrity.
sections.title: Trust Recovery Requirements

sections.content: Bootstrap must not start automatically. Acceptance, Quick Dev, and related validators preserve lifecycle ownership, reject stale or conflicting evidence, maintain immutable historical records, and publish only recomputed non-authorizing results.
sections.title: Execution Constraints
